skill.minerpg.asc_bulwark_deep_1.descrip: Blocking with a shield makes you take less damage for 3 seconds.
skill.minerpg.asc_bulwark_deep_1.title: Steadfast
skill.minerpg.asc_bulwark_deep_2.descrip: When hit in melee, you smite the attacker with holy light. At most once every 2 seconds.
skill.minerpg.asc_bulwark_deep_2.title: Holy Retort
skill.minerpg.asc_bulwark_deep_3.title: Unyielding
skill.minerpg.asc_bulwark_emp_dragon.des: Bastion of Light heals allies inside 1 heart every second.
skill.minerpg.asc_bulwark_emp_wither.des: Enemies inside Bastion of Light burn with holy fire.
skill.minerpg.asc_bulwark_fate.descripti: Hold the Line: +20% max health. Blocking with a shield heals you and makes enemies within 6 blocks attack you.
skill.minerpg.asc_bulwark_fate.title: Bulwark
skill.minerpg.asc_bulwark_trans_1.descri: Divine Protection also protects allies within 6 blocks.
skill.minerpg.asc_bulwark_trans_1.title: Shared Protection
skill.minerpg.asc_bulwark_trans_2.descri: Allies standing in your Battle Banner also take less damage.
skill.minerpg.asc_bulwark_trans_2.title: Banner of Resolve
skill.minerpg.asc_bulwark_ultimate.descr: Ultimate (Ender Guardian): plant a dome 8 blocks wide for 8 seconds. Allies inside take 60% less damage and enemies inside are slowed. You cannot move while it stands. 120 s cooldown.
skill.minerpg.asc_bulwark_ultimate.title: Bastion of Light
skill.minerpg.asc_crusader_deep_1.descri: A kill gives +20% attack speed for 3 seconds.
skill.minerpg.asc_crusader_deep_1.title: Zeal
skill.minerpg.asc_crusader_deep_2.title: Consuming Light
skill.minerpg.asc_crusader_deep_3.descri: Your melee hits heal you for 3% of the damage dealt.
skill.minerpg.asc_crusader_deep_3.title: Light's Reprisal
skill.minerpg.asc_crusader_emp_dragon.de: While Avatar of Light lasts you fall slowly and jump higher.
skill.minerpg.asc_crusader_emp_wither.de: While Avatar of Light lasts, allies within 8 blocks heal 2% of the damage you deal.
skill.minerpg.asc_crusader_fate.descript: Blessed Arms: your melee hits deal extra holy damage equal to 30% of your healing power.
skill.minerpg.asc_crusader_fate.title: Crusader
skill.minerpg.asc_crusader_trans_1.descr: Judgement leaps you to its target.
skill.minerpg.asc_crusader_trans_1.title: Avenger's Leap
skill.minerpg.asc_crusader_trans_2.descr: Judgement stuns 2 seconds longer and sets its target ablaze.
skill.minerpg.asc_crusader_trans_2.title: Searing Judgement
skill.minerpg.asc_crusader_ultimate.desc: Ultimate (Ender Guardian): for 10 seconds, wings of light: +30% attack damage, immunity to fire, and every melee hit sends out a holy shockwave. 90 s cooldown.
skill.minerpg.asc_juggernaut_deep_1.desc: You take 10% less damage while above half health.
skill.minerpg.asc_juggernaut_deep_2.desc: Blocking with a shield knocks back the attacker and enemies near it.
skill.minerpg.asc_juggernaut_deep_3.desc: Dropping below 30% health gives you strong regeneration for 5 seconds. Once per minute.
While Colossus lasts, allies within 8 blocks take 20% less damage.
Colossus ends with a ground slam that stuns enemies within 6 blocks for 2 seconds.
skill.minerpg.asc_juggernaut_fate.descri: Unstoppable: +30% max health and +4 armor. Charge knocks enemies aside and makes them attack you.
skill.minerpg.asc_juggernaut_fate.drawba: Drawback: -15% movement speed and attack speed.
skill.minerpg.asc_juggernaut_fate.title: Juggernaut
skill.minerpg.asc_juggernaut_trans_1.des: While Last Stand lasts, enemies within 8 blocks attack you, and 30% of the damage you take strikes back at the attacker.
skill.minerpg.asc_juggernaut_trans_2.des: Shout also gives you and every ally within 8 blocks a barrier that absorbs 4 damage for 8 seconds.
skill.minerpg.asc_juggernaut_ultimate.de: Ultimate (Ender Guardian): for 10 seconds you grow 30% larger, cannot be knocked back, and take 50% less damage. 90 s cooldown.
skill.minerpg.asc_lightbinder_deep_1.des: When you heal an ally below 30% health, the heal lands twice.
skill.minerpg.asc_lightbinder_deep_3.des: Allies within 6 blocks of you take 8% less damage.
skill.minerpg.asc_lightbinder_emp_dragon: Dawnfall starts by cleansing every harmful effect from your allies.
skill.minerpg.asc_lightbinder_emp_wither: Dawnfall lasts 4 seconds longer, and allies heal 5% of their health every second during it.
skill.minerpg.asc_lightbinder_fate.descr: Overflow: healing beyond full health becomes a barrier (up to 6 hearts). +30% healing power.
skill.minerpg.asc_lightbinder_fate.title: Lightbinder
skill.minerpg.asc_lightbinder_trans_1.de: Your Barrier heals allies standing near it every second.
skill.minerpg.asc_lightbinder_trans_2.de: Each heal from your Lightwell also removes one harmful effect.
skill.minerpg.asc_lightbinder_ultimate.d: Ultimate (Ender Guardian): for 8 seconds every heal you cast also lands on every ally within 12 blocks, and an ally who would die is held at 1 health instead (once each). 120 s cooldown.
skill.minerpg.asc_nightblade_deep_1.desc: A kill gives +25% movement speed and attack speed for 4 seconds.
skill.minerpg.asc_nightblade_deep_2.desc: Ambush hits crack the target's armor (Shatter) for 5 seconds.
skill.minerpg.asc_nightblade_deep_3.desc: Dropping below 30% health hides you in Vanish. Once per minute.
Thousand Cuts also makes its targets bleed.
Each kill by Thousand Cuts takes 10 seconds off its cooldown.
skill.minerpg.asc_nightblade_fate.descri: Ambush: your first melee hit after Vanish or Shadow Step deals +150% damage.
skill.minerpg.asc_nightblade_fate.title: Nightblade
skill.minerpg.asc_nightblade_trans_1.des: Shadow Step's cooldown resets if its target dies within 3 seconds.
skill.minerpg.asc_nightblade_trans_2.des: Leaving Vanish blinds and slows enemies within 4 blocks for 2 seconds.
skill.minerpg.asc_nightblade_ultimate.de: Ultimate (Ender Guardian): a storm of blades hits every enemy within 6 blocks for heavy weapon damage. Every hit is critical. 60 s cooldown.
skill.minerpg.asc_plaguefang_deep_1.desc: When a poisoned enemy dies, its Venom jumps to the nearest enemy.
skill.minerpg.asc_plaguefang_deep_2.desc: Enemies with 3 or more Venom stacks are slowed by 30%.
Plague Bloom reaches 50% further, and you heal for each enemy inside it.
Enemies that die inside Plague Bloom burst, giving nearby enemies full Venom.
skill.minerpg.asc_plaguefang_fate.descri: Venom: every melee hit adds a stack of Fatal Poison (up to 5).
skill.minerpg.asc_plaguefang_fate.title: Plaguefang
skill.minerpg.asc_plaguefang_trans_1.des: Mutilate tears the Venom out of its target in one burst of damage.
skill.minerpg.asc_plaguefang_trans_2.des: Bear Trap adds 3 Venom stacks and spreads them to enemies within 4 blocks.
skill.minerpg.asc_plaguefang_ultimate.de: Ultimate (Ender Guardian): for 8 seconds a toxic cloud follows you. Enemies within 5 blocks gain a Venom stack every second and deal less damage. 60 s cooldown.
skill.minerpg.asc_reaver_deep_1.descript: Each kill gives +10% attack speed for 6 seconds, stacking 3 times.
skill.minerpg.asc_reaver_deep_1.title: Momentum
skill.minerpg.asc_reaver_deep_2.descript: Mortal Strike also hits enemies next to its target for half its damage.
skill.minerpg.asc_reaver_deep_2.title: Cleave
skill.minerpg.asc_reaver_deep_3.descript: +15% melee damage against enemies below half health.
skill.minerpg.asc_reaver_deep_3.title: Scent of Blood
skill.minerpg.asc_reaver_emp_dragon.desc: While Rampage lasts, you heal for 15% of the damage you deal.
skill.minerpg.asc_reaver_emp_wither.desc: Each kill during Rampage makes it last 1 second longer.
skill.minerpg.asc_reaver_fate.descriptio: Finisher: Mortal Strike deals double damage to enemies below 35% health, and kills reset Charge.
skill.minerpg.asc_reaver_fate.title: Reaver
skill.minerpg.asc_reaver_trans_1.descrip: Throw kills any enemy below 15% health outright (not bosses).
skill.minerpg.asc_reaver_trans_1.title: Headsman's Throw
skill.minerpg.asc_reaver_trans_2.descrip: Mortal Strike's bleed is stronger, and Mortal Strike heals you for 20% of its damage.
skill.minerpg.asc_reaver_trans_2.title: Bloodletting
skill.minerpg.asc_reaver_ultimate.descri: Ultimate (Ender Guardian): for 8 seconds every kill resets your spell cooldowns, and you move 30% faster. 90 s cooldown.
skill.minerpg.asc_reaver_ultimate.title: Rampage
skill.minerpg.asc_zealot_deep_1.descript: Each holy hit gives +3% spell haste for 5 seconds, stacking 5 times.
skill.minerpg.asc_zealot_deep_1.title: Fervor
skill.minerpg.asc_zealot_deep_2.descript: When you are hit, enemies within 4 blocks take holy damage.
skill.minerpg.asc_zealot_deep_2.title: Martyrdom
skill.minerpg.asc_zealot_deep_3.title: Smite the Wicked
skill.minerpg.asc_zealot_emp_dragon.desc: Wrath of Dawn's pillars stun for 1 second.
skill.minerpg.asc_zealot_fate.descriptio: Righteous Fire: 40% of the holy damage you deal heals the most injured ally near you (yourself included).
skill.minerpg.asc_zealot_fate.drawback: Drawback: -30% healing power on your heals.
skill.minerpg.asc_zealot_fate.title: Zealot
skill.minerpg.asc_zealot_trans_1.descrip: Penance's bolts jump to a second enemy.
skill.minerpg.asc_zealot_trans_1.title: Chained Penance
skill.minerpg.asc_zealot_trans_2.descrip: Holy Beam leaves burning holy ground under its target for 4 seconds.
skill.minerpg.asc_zealot_trans_2.title: Hallowed Ground
skill.minerpg.asc_zealot_ultimate.descri: Ultimate (Ender Guardian): over 3 seconds, 5 pillars of light strike enemies around you; each one heals allies near it. 90 s cooldown.
skill.minerpg.asc_zealot_ultimate.title: Wrath of Dawn
